name: robots/agilexrobotics__ugv_gazebo_sim
title: AgileX Scout V2 Gazebo empty world
intro: AgileX Scout V2 Gazebo empty world, adapted from agilexrobotics/ugv_gazebo_sim. It runs `publish_cmd_vel`. `publish_cmd_vel`: publish geometry_msgs/Twist linear.x and angular.z on /cmd_vel. TwistCmdCallback converts them to four Float64 wheel commands and stores no Twist. The receipt is transmission evidence and the values sent, not a measured velocity and not a cleared controller. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
